What decided the game?

Source: R/games.R
game_factors.Rd

Splits each game's margin into Dean Oliver's four factors. Across all the games supplied, the margin is regressed on the four differences between the teams (eFG%, turnover rate, offensive-rebound rate, free-throw rate); a game's contribution of a factor is its coefficient times that game's difference, in points. What the factors leave over (mostly the number of possessions and how they ended) is other.

Usage

game_factors(teams, coefs = NULL, min_games = 30)

Arguments

teams

Team-game box scores from box_score(pbp, by = "team"), many games (a season), both teams of each game.

coefs

Coefficients to use instead of fitting them (named d_efg, d_tov, d_orb, d_ftr).

min_games

With fewer games than this (and no coefs), the coefficients fitted on every 2024/25 game of the league are used, so a single game can be explained on its own.

Value

The four factors per team and game plus margin, the four contributions (c_shooting, c_turnovers, c_rebounding, c_free_throws), c_other; the model (if fitted) is attached as attribute fit.
